title: Provable Scaling Laws for the Test-Time Compute of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Yanxi Chen、Xuchen Pan、Yaliang Li、Bolin Ding、Jingren Zhou（机构：Alibaba Group）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算扩展理论与实证研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 设计候选生成、比较和聚合流程而不依赖外部验证器的读者。
one_line: The paper gives knockout and league aggregation algorithms with provable error decay as black-box LLM inference compute grows.
该论文以淘汰赛和联赛式候选聚合证明：黑箱语言模型的测试时调用增加可使错误率按可刻画规律下降。
why: It states the assumptions under which more generation and comparison calls can reliably improve a final answer.
inclusion_reason: It formalizes how candidate generation and self-comparison consume inference calls, with explicit error-scaling guarantees and empirical tests.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Repeated sampling is an obvious way to spend additional inference compute, but it does not say how the final candidate should be selected. Best-of-N needs a reliable verifier and can be misled by an adversarial-looking answer; majority vote can also become worse as N grows when the most frequent answer is wrong. Thus a larger call budget alone is not a scaling law: the selection mechanism must use the generated candidates in a way that remains reliable as their number increases.

This paper asks for black-box inference procedures whose probability of returning a correct answer can be driven toward one by spending more test-time calls under explicit assumptions. The relevant record contains independently generated candidates, their pairwise comparison outcomes, the tournament or league aggregation decision, and total call count. The question is therefore both operational and theoretical: how should calls be divided between generation and comparison, and under what conditions does that division improve rather than destabilize the final answer?

重复采样是使用额外推理计算的直观方式，但它没有说明应怎样选择最终候选。最佳候选式方法需要可靠验证器，且可能被表面上像正确答案的对抗性候选误导；当出现频率最高的答案本身是错的时，多数投票也可能随着候选数 N 增加而变差。因此，更大的调用预算本身并不是标度律：选择机制必须能以在候选增多时仍保持可靠的方式利用生成结果。

本文寻求只依赖黑箱推理的过程：在明确假设下，通过增加测试时调用，返回正确答案的概率可被推向一。相关记录包含独立生成的候选、它们的两两比较结果、淘汰赛或联赛式聚合决定，以及总调用次数。因此问题同时具有操作和理论性质：调用应如何在生成与比较之间分配，在什么条件下这种分配会提升而不是破坏最终答案？

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper replaces a single scalar verifier with structured self-comparison among candidate answers. In the knockout algorithm, the system samples N solutions and repeatedly pairs candidates; the model compares each pair, a winner advances, and the remaining winner is returned. If the model has a nonzero chance of generating a correct candidate and compares a correct-versus-incorrect pair better than random chance, the analysis bounds the failure probability as test-time calls grow.

The league algorithm avoids eliminating a good candidate after one unlucky loss. It evaluates each candidate by an average win rate against several opponents and returns the strongest aggregate scorer. Under a more robust condition on the average win rates of correct and incorrect solutions, its failure probability also decreases exponentially. Both methods expose the same auditable objects: candidate pool, comparison protocol, votes or win rates, aggregation decision, and number of calls, without adding a separately trained reward model.

论文以候选答案之间的结构化自比较取代单一标量验证器。在淘汰赛算法中，系统采样 N 个解答并反复将候选配对；模型比较每一对，胜者晋级，最后留下的胜者即为输出。若模型生成正确候选的概率非零，并且比较正确与错误候选时优于随机猜测，分析便可在测试时调用增加时给出失败概率的界。

联赛算法避免了优秀候选因一次不走运的失败而被淘汰。它按每个候选对多个对手的平均胜率进行评估，并返回聚合得分最高者；在关于正确与错误解答平均胜率的更稳健条件下，其失败概率同样会指数下降。两种方法都公开相同的可审计对象：候选池、比较协议、投票或胜率、聚合决定和调用数量，而不再加入单独训练的奖励模型。

title: Method
方法
html:
For knockout aggregation, the system first samples N independent solutions for an input. It organizes them into a binary tournament and asks the same black-box language model to decide pairwise winners; repeated comparisons can be used for each match. The paper separates two risks: no sampled candidate is correct, and a comparison mistakenly eliminates a correct one. Its theorems combine those risks to show exponential or power-law decay in failure, depending on which quantities are scaled.

For league aggregation, each candidate is compared with several opponents and is ranked by mean win rate rather than a single elimination event. The reported experiments use GPQA, MMLU-Pro-S, and MATH-500, and include Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, GPT-4o, and QwQ-32B in different settings. The budget is total language-model calls for candidate generation plus comparison; correctness is measured on the benchmark, so a reproduction must retain both the initial samples and every comparison decision rather than logging only the final answer.

在淘汰赛聚合中，系统先为一个输入独立采样 N 个解答，将它们组织成二叉竞赛，再要求同一个黑箱语言模型决定两两对局的胜者；每一场可以进行重复比较。论文分离了两种风险：没有任何采样候选是正确的，以及比较错误地淘汰了正确候选。其定理把这两种风险组合起来，说明随着不同量的扩展，失败概率会以指数或幂律形式下降。

在联赛聚合中，每个候选与多个对手比较，并按平均胜率排序，而非由一次淘汰事件决定。报告的实验使用 GPQA、MMLU-Pro-S 和 MATH-500，并在不同设置下包括 Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、GPT-4o 与 QwQ-32B。预算是候选生成加比较所用的语言模型调用总数，正确性按基准衡量；因此复现时必须保留初始样本与每一次比较决定，不能只记录最终答案。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The theoretical evidence identifies the conditions rather than claiming unconditional improvement. For knockout selection, a correct answer must be generated with nonzero probability and a correct candidate must beat an incorrect one with probability above one half in pairwise comparison. Under those assumptions, the stated failure bound decays exponentially or by a power law as total calls grow. For league selection, the paper states a stronger average-win-rate separation condition and derives exponential decay.

The empirical section tests the procedures across GPQA, MMLU-Pro-S, and MATH-500 with multiple language models, including Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, GPT-4o, and QwQ-32B. It reports increasing accuracy with candidate count in the studied settings and examines both knockout and league variants. This supports the practical relevance of the assumptions on those tasks, but it does not measure a universal theorem for every model: a deployment must still check pairwise-comparison reliability and the cost of the extra calls in its own environment.

理论证据明确给出条件，而不是宣称无条件提升。对淘汰赛选择而言，必须以非零概率生成正确答案，且正确候选在两两比较中击败错误候选的概率应高于二分之一；在这些假设下，所述失败界会随总调用增加按指数或幂律下降。对联赛选择，论文提出更强的平均胜率分离条件，并得到指数下降结论。

实证部分在 GPQA、MMLU-Pro-S 和 MATH-500 上，使用包括 Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、GPT-4o 和 QwQ-32B 在内的多种语言模型测试这些过程。论文报告，在研究设置中准确率会随候选数增加而提高，并考察了淘汰赛与联赛两种变体。这支持这些假设在所测任务上的实际相关性，但并未为每个模型给出普适定理：部署时仍需检查自身环境中的两两比较可靠性和额外调用成本。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest alternatives either select candidates with an external verifier or aggregate them by a rule such as majority vote without a general reliability guarantee. This paper changes the inference object into a two-stage generation-and-comparison protocol and analyzes its full failure probability. The selection signal is produced by the same black-box model through pairwise judgments, but the paper specifies what that judge must do well for scaling to be meaningful.

The league variant further changes the decision from a sequence of irreversible single matches to an average over opponents, making the comparative evidence for a candidate more robust to an individual bad judgment. The new contribution is not a proof that language models are perfect judges, nor a substitute for task-specific verification. It is an explicit bridge from a comparison contract and a call budget to a measurable error-scaling claim that can be tested before the procedure is reused.

最接近的替代方案要么以外部验证器选择候选，要么采用多数投票等规则聚合候选，却没有一般性的可靠性保证。本文把推理对象改成两阶段的生成—比较协议，并分析其完整失败概率。选择信号由同一黑箱模型的两两判断产生，但论文明确了该判断器必须在哪些方面优于随机，扩展才有意义。

联赛变体进一步把决策从一连串不可逆的单场对局改为对多个对手的平均，使某个候选的比较证据不那么容易受到一次错误判断影响。新贡献不是证明语言模型是完美裁判，也不是替代任务特定验证；它在比较契约、调用预算与可测量的误差扩展主张之间建立了明确桥梁，并允许复用前先测试该主张。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The guarantees depend on behavioral assumptions that can fail precisely on difficult or adversarial inputs: the base model must sometimes generate a correct solution, and its pairwise judgments must reliably favor correct candidates. Candidate outputs may be correlated, comparisons can be position-sensitive, and a large number of calls can be expensive or slow even when the call-count curve improves. Before reuse, estimate generation and comparison accuracy on representative inputs, randomize pair order, and report wall-clock, price, and call counts separately.
这些保证依赖的行为假设恰可能在困难或对抗性输入上失效：基础模型必须有时能生成正确解答，并且两两判断必须可靠地偏向正确候选。候选输出可能高度相关，比较可能对位置敏感，而且即使调用数曲线改善，大量调用也可能昂贵或缓慢。复用前应在代表性输入上估计生成与比较准确率，随机化候选顺序，并分别报告实际运行时间、价格和调用次数。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this study as a baseline when a system can sample several candidate solutions but has no separately trained verifier. The minimal replay record is the prompt, every generated candidate, each pair and presentation order, comparison result, aggregation score, total calls, latency, final answer, and correctness. This makes it possible to audit whether improvement comes from generation coverage, comparison quality, or a hidden change in budget, and to decide whether knockout or league aggregation fits the available serving constraints.
当系统可以采样多个候选解答却没有单独训练的验证器时，可将本研究作为基线。最小可回放记录应包含提示、每个生成候选、每一对候选及展示顺序、比较结果、聚合分数、总调用数、延迟、最终答案和正确性。这样可以审计提升来自生成覆盖、比较质量还是隐藏的预算变化，并据可用的服务约束决定淘汰赛还是联赛聚合更合适。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the assumptions before the curves. The key question is not whether a tournament sounds plausible, but whether the chosen model has a positive correct-generation probability and a pairwise comparison advantage on the target distribution. Then track the budget accounting: generation and comparison both consume calls, and league robustness normally requires more comparisons. Finally compare the method against majority vote and verifier-based best-of-N at equal end-to-end cost, because the theorems explain a specific comparison contract rather than free accuracy from extra samples.
先读假设，再读曲线。关键不在于淘汰赛听起来是否合理，而在于所选模型在目标分布上是否具有正的正确生成概率和两两比较优势；随后追踪预算统计，因为生成和比较都会消耗调用，联赛的稳健性通常需要更多比较。最后应在相同端到端成本下，将该方法与多数投票和基于验证器的最佳候选比较，因为定理解释的是一种特定比较契约，并非额外采样带来的免费准确率。
